meanings.en: performs or completes a task, duty, or plan
meanings.exampleEn: She carries out all the safety checks before the machine is used.
meanings.exampleTr: Makine kullanılmadan önce tüm güvenlik kontrollerini o yapar.

meanings.en: a machine in a shop that records sales and holds money
meanings.exampleEn: The cashier counted the money in the cash register at closing time.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasiyer kapanış saatinde yazar kasadaki parayı saydı.

meanings.en: a small locked box for keeping money
meanings.exampleEn: He kept the day's takings in a metal cashbox under the counter.
meanings.exampleTr: Günün gelirini tezgahın altındaki metal para kutusunda tutuyordu.

meanings.en: to surprise someone when they are not prepared
meanings.exampleEn: The sudden question caught her off guard and she didn't know what to say.
meanings.exampleTr: Ani soru onu gafil avladı ve ne diyeceğini bilemedi.

meanings.tr: telafi, açığı kapatma; hasret giderme sohbeti
meanings.en: an act of doing something you missed, or reaching the same level as others
meanings.exampleEn: After being ill, she had a lot of catch-up to do with her studies.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalandıktan sonra dersleriyle ilgili kapatması gereken çok açık vardı.

meanings.en: past tense and past participle of catch; grabbed or captured
meanings.exampleEn: He caught the ball just before it hit the ground.
meanings.exampleTr: Top yere düşmeden hemen önce onu yakaladı.

meanings.en: became ill with a disease
meanings.exampleEn: She caught a cold after walking in the rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmurda yürüdükten sonra soğuk algınlığına yakalandı.

meanings.en: to fall down or inward suddenly
meanings.exampleEn: The roof of the old tunnel began to cave in during the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski tünelin tavanı fırtına sırasında çökmeye başladı.

meanings.en: to finally agree to something after resisting
meanings.exampleEn: After hours of pressure, the manager caved in to their demands.
meanings.exampleTr: Saatlerce süren baskının ardından müdür taleplerine boyun eğdi.

meanings.en: an agreement to stop fighting for a period of time
meanings.exampleEn: Both sides agreed to a ceasefire after months of conflict.
meanings.exampleTr: İki taraf aylarca süren çatışmanın ardından ateşkes üzerinde anlaştı.

meanings.en: continuing without stopping
meanings.exampleEn: The ceaseless noise from the traffic kept her awake all night.
meanings.exampleTr: Trafikten gelen aralıksız gürültü bütün gece onu uyutmadı.

meanings.en: to give up power, land, or rights, usually formally
meanings.exampleEn: The defeated country was forced to cede several regions to its neighbour.
meanings.exampleTr: Yenilen ülke, birkaç bölgeyi komşusuna bırakmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: a main computer that controls or stores data for a whole system
meanings.exampleEn: All the store's sales data is sent to the central computer overnight.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağazanın tüm satış verileri gece boyunca merkezi bilgisayara gönderilir.

meanings.tr: ana hikaye örgüsü, merkezi olay örgüsü
meanings.en: the main plot around which a story is built
meanings.exampleEn: The central storyline follows a young girl searching for her lost brother.
meanings.exampleTr: Ana hikaye örgüsü, kayıp kardeşini arayan genç bir kızı takip eder.

meanings.en: the middle point or part of something
meanings.exampleEn: There is a large fountain in the centre of the square.
meanings.exampleTr: Meydanın merkezinde büyük bir çeşme var.

meanings.en: a place used for a particular activity or service
meanings.exampleEn: They opened a new sports centre near the school.
meanings.exampleTr: Okulun yakınında yeni bir spor merkezi açtılar.

meanings.en: the stopping of something, especially formally
meanings.exampleEn: The treaty called for an immediate cessation of all military action.
meanings.exampleTr: Antlaşma, tüm askeri harekatın derhal durdurulmasını öngörüyordu.

meanings.en: a marine mammal such as a whale, dolphin, or porpoise
meanings.exampleEn: The dolphin is a cetacean that lives in oceans all over the world.
meanings.exampleTr: Yunus, dünyanın her yerindeki okyanuslarda yaşayan bir deniz memelisidir.

meanings.en: to find or meet something or someone by chance
meanings.exampleEn: I chanced upon an old friend while walking through the market.
meanings.exampleTr: Pazarda dolaşırken eski bir arkadaşıma tesadüfen rastladım.

meanings.en: the way a writer creates and describes characters in a story
meanings.exampleEn: The novel is praised for its rich characterization of the main figures.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, ana figürlerinin zengin karakterizasyonu nedeniyle övülüyor.

meanings.en: a description of the qualities of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: His characterization of the plan as risky upset the board.
meanings.exampleTr: Planı riskli olarak nitelendirmesi yönetim kurulunu rahatsız etti.

meanings.en: a very deep crack or opening in the ground
meanings.exampleEn: The climbers carefully crossed a narrow bridge over the chasm.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağcılar, uçurumun üzerindeki dar köprüden dikkatlice geçtiler.

meanings.en: a large difference between two groups or ideas
meanings.exampleEn: There is a growing chasm between the rich and the poor.
meanings.exampleTr: Zenginlerle yoksullar arasında giderek büyüyen bir uçurum var.

meanings.en: someone who dislikes spending money, in an unpleasant way
meanings.exampleEn: Don't be such a cheapskate and buy her a proper birthday present.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar cimri olma da ona doğru düzgün bir doğum günü hediyesi al.

meanings.en: the act of leaving a hotel, or the place where you pay in a shop
meanings.exampleEn: Please leave your room key at the front desk before check-out.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen otelden çıkış öncesi oda anahtarınızı resepsiyona bırakın.

meanings.en: a person or device that checks or verifies something
meanings.exampleEn: The spell checker underlined every word that was misspelled.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazım denetleyicisi yanlış yazılan her kelimenin altını çizdi.

meanings.en: elegant and fashionable in style
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a chic black dress to the evening reception.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam resepsiyonuna şık bir siyah elbise giydi.

meanings.en: the care of children, especially while parents are at work
meanings.exampleEn: Good childcare can be expensive for working parents.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi çocuk bakımı, çalışan ebeveynler için pahalı olabilir.

meanings.en: a small hot-tasting pepper used in cooking
meanings.exampleEn: He added a fresh chilli to make the curry spicier.
meanings.exampleTr: Köriyi daha acı yapmak için taze bir acı biber ekledi.

meanings.en: having many small rough waves
meanings.exampleEn: The sea was too choppy for the small boats to go out.
meanings.exampleTr: Deniz, küçük teknelerin açılması için fazla dalgalıydı.

meanings.en: not smooth or flowing; jerky
meanings.exampleEn: His writing style is choppy, with many very short sentences.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazı stili, birçok çok kısa cümleyle kesik kesiktir.

meanings.en: selected as the best or preferred option
meanings.exampleEn: She finally started work in her chosen career.
meanings.exampleTr: Nihayet seçtiği kariyerde çalışmaya başladı.

meanings.en: slightly fat in a pleasant way
meanings.exampleEn: The baby had chubby little cheeks that everyone wanted to pinch.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebeğin, herkesin çimdiklemek istediği tombul yanakları vardı.

meanings.en: something that is very easy to do
meanings.exampleEn: With the right tools, fixing the tap was a cinch.
meanings.exampleTr: Doğru aletlerle musluğu tamir etmek çok kolaydı.

meanings.en: a device that stops the flow of electricity when it is unsafe
meanings.exampleEn: The circuit breaker tripped when too many appliances were switched on.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok fazla cihaz açıldığında devre kesici attı.

meanings.en: a strong castle that protects a city
meanings.exampleEn: The ancient citadel stood on a hill above the old town.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik kale, eski şehrin üzerindeki bir tepede duruyordu.

meanings.en: the central part of a city where most shops and offices are
meanings.exampleEn: We took a bus to the city centre to do some shopping.
meanings.exampleTr: Biraz alışveriş yapmak için şehir merkezine otobüsle gittik.

meanings.tr: medeni özgürlükler, temel hak ve özgürlükler
meanings.en: the freedoms that citizens have, such as free speech, protected by law
meanings.exampleEn: The new law was criticized for restricting civil liberties.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa, medeni özgürlükleri kısıtladığı için eleştirildi.

meanings.en: a loud noise made by many people or a loud demand
meanings.exampleEn: There was a clamor of voices as the crowd demanded answers.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık cevap isterken bir ses gürültüsü koptu.

meanings.en: to demand something loudly and insistently
meanings.exampleEn: Reporters clamored for a statement from the minister.
meanings.exampleTr: Muhabirler bakandan bir açıklama için yaygara kopardı.

meanings.en: in a secret way, especially because something is not allowed
meanings.exampleEn: The documents were clandestinely passed to a foreign agent.
meanings.exampleTr: Belgeler gizlice bir yabancı ajana verildi.

meanings.en: to make a loud, dull metallic sound
meanings.exampleEn: The heavy chains clanked as the drawbridge was lowered.
meanings.exampleTr: Asma köprü indirilirken ağır zincirler şangırdadı.

meanings.en: language that is easy to understand
meanings.exampleEn: The instructions were written in clear language so everyone could follow them.
meanings.exampleTr: Talimatlar, herkesin takip edebilmesi için anlaşılır bir dille yazılmıştı.

meanings.en: able to think clearly and sensibly
meanings.exampleEn: She stayed clear-headed and calm during the emergency.
meanings.exampleTr: Acil durum boyunca aklı başında ve sakin kaldı.

meanings.en: official permission for something to happen
meanings.exampleEn: The pilot waited for clearance from the control tower before taking off.
meanings.exampleTr: Pilot kalkıştan önce kuleden izin gelmesini bekledi.

meanings.en: the sale of goods at low prices to get rid of them
meanings.exampleEn: I bought this coat at half price in the clearance sale.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu paltoyu tasfiye satışında yarı fiyatına aldım.

meanings.en: able to think clearly and make good decisions
meanings.exampleEn: You need to be clearheaded to make such an important choice.
meanings.exampleTr: Böylesine önemli bir seçim yapmak için aklının başında olması gerekir.

meanings.en: a heavy knife with a wide blade used to cut meat
meanings.exampleEn: The butcher split the bone with a single blow of his cleaver.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasap, satırının tek darbesiyle kemiği ikiye ayırdı.

meanings.en: a phrase or idea used so often that it is no longer interesting
meanings.exampleEn: "Only time will tell" is a tired old cliché.
meanings.exampleTr: "Zaman gösterecek" yıpranmış eski bir klişedir.

meanings.en: spoken in short, quick sounds, often sounding cold
meanings.exampleEn: She answered in a clipped voice that showed she was annoyed.
meanings.exampleTr: Rahatsız olduğunu gösteren kesik bir sesle cevap verdi.

meanings.en: to stop operating permanently, or to make a business stop
meanings.exampleEn: The factory had to close down after losing its main customer.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika, ana müşterisini kaybettikten sonra kapanmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: unwilling to consider new ideas or opinions
meanings.exampleEn: He was too closed-minded to accept that he might be wrong.
meanings.exampleTr: Yanılıyor olabileceğini kabul edemeyecek kadar dar görüşlüydü.
